highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.1 picks up the latest upstream Skia m155 bug fixes without changing managed APIs.

bullets.detail: The native engine moves to the newest upstream chrome/m155 commit, bringing its bug fixes into this servicing release.
The Windows ANGLE build uses a reviewed resource-compiler script instead of downloading Chromium's prebuilt rc.exe. This changes only how the native binaries are built.

v4.155.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.1 updates the native engine to the latest Skia m155 fixes.
v4.155.1.body: The Windows ANGLE build no longer downloads a prebuilt resource compiler. Managed APIs are unchanged.
